identity.name: Iran International
identity.description: A London-based Persian-language satellite and digital news network covering Iran, its diaspora and regional affairs, with an English-language service.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Backed by Saudi-linked private investors, according to multiple media reports; the outlet denies funding from or ties to the Saudi government. It actively promotes former Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi and is designated a terrorist organisation by Iran.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Editorially independent of the Iranian government and strongly oppositional, but opaque financing and Saudi-linked investment reports create significant alignment risk.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No parsed MBFC rating; self-assessed as centrist with a pronounced anti-regime and pro-Pahlavi editorial stance, which can push coverage rightward on Iran.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is secondary and largely framed through sanctions, regime accountability and diaspora investment.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Openly opposes the Islamic Republic and promotes regime change, with reported Saudi-linked financing; its international alignment is therefore contested.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Professional newsroom with original Iran reporting, but opaque ownership and advocacy positioning require corroboration of politically sensitive claims.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No clean MBFC rating parsed for Iran International.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Oppositional Iranian coverage with a strong anti-regime and pro-diaspora lens, useful for protest and human-rights stories but requiring corroboration.

selectionRationale: Adds rare Iran-focused reporting and diaspora voices, balanced by explicit funding and alignment caveats.

feeds.validationNote: 50 items; valid RSS; iranintl.com/en/rss returned invalid/empty.

research.researchNotes: Official About page accessible but thin. Financing is disputed and based on secondary reporting; profile must remain DRAFT pending documentary verification. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
